notes.title: A Waitress Is on Her Way!
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Running a pizzeria is more than just baking – it’s about keeping your customers happy, managing the dining room, and handling the growing crowd. And when the place starts getting busy, you won’t be able to do it all alone. But don’t worry – help is on the way!

[b]Meet the Waitress![/b]

Today we’re sharing the first look at our in-progress waitress character. She’s still in development, but we’re excited to show you her early concept art and 3D design work. From outfit ideas to first animations – she’s getting closer to making her debut in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/2f44f22c67baed53690b9b6db39977fc577d5971.png[/img]

The waitress will be your right hand in the dining room – taking orders at the tables, serving pizzas, and making sure your guests leave with a smile. With her on board, you’ll be able to focus more on baking, upgrading your place, and growing your business.

[b]When Will She Join the Team?[/b]

At the start of the game, you’ll be the chef, the boss, and the manager all in one. But as your pizzeria grows and traffic picks up, you’ll unlock the option to hire staff – and that’s when the waitress comes in. You’ll choose when and how to bring her on board, depending on your strategy and needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/bcb99dae88aab79f42bda4c7cfa56c877fcc791a.png[/img]

Let us know what you think of her design on Discord – your feedback is always appreciated. And don’t forget to wishlist Pizza Slice on Steam to keep up with the latest updates!

[h3]See you at the table![/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/D8FUrZzTpD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/d06624c13da5350470281ab8e0eb423553313bd8.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Looking Back on 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Time flies and we're not slowing down! It's been an incredibly exciting year for our team and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290][b]Pizza Slice[/b][/url] project - a year of change, challenge, and growth. We started our journey as [i]Pizza Simulator[/i], but as time went on the project underwent a huge transformation, both in the game itself and in its identity. The new name - [b]Pizza Slice[/b] - perfectly reflects what we want to offer: a slice (or rather a full portion) of the great fun of running your own pizzeria!

In this devlog, we recap the major changes and events of the year, but that's not all! We look behind the scenes, discuss where we're heading in the coming months, and let you know what's in store for players in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/a76f0c0ab656228ccad57001ad7368fb2b57a196.png[/img]
[h2]New name, new vision[/h2]
After a long absence from our side in the first half of the year (for which we apologize), we returned with a big change this November. A new name, a refreshed Steam page, and a different direction for the game. It was an extremely important moment for us but your response exceeded our expectations. Your embrace of the changes, positive comments, and feedback have given us even more motivation and reassurance that we are on the right track. 

With these changes, [b]Pizza Slice[/b] communicates what it is better – it's not just a game, but a full-fledged, humorous adventure that immerses the player in the world of running their own pizzeria. From competing with local restaurants to solving everyday problems and making tough business decisions, our vision has come full circle.

One of the highlights of this year was the announcement of the game's release. [b]Coming in 2025, Pizza Slice[/b] will challenge you to manage a pizzeria and bake the best pizza ever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/977dfee2ac1c05539b1b01cf286fe6a2b9f15081.png[/img]
[h2]What was going on behind the scenes?[/h2]
Over the past few weeks, Pizza Slice has undergone a number of significant changes that will take the game to a whole new level!

First of all, we have improved the fluidity and visuals of the game. These improvements make the town, your pizzeria and of course the pizzas themselves look even more inviting!

We also didn't forget to make the game world more dynamic and alive. Improved NPC behavior makes the townspeople react more naturally, and interactions with them are more interesting and satisfying.
We also redesigned the dough kneading system to make it more intuitive and engaging.

But creating [b]Pizza Slice [/b]isn't just about coding and designing mechanics, it's also a lot of artistic work and creative brainstorming. From the initial sketches of the pizzeria to the design of the characters to the details that create the atmosphere of the game, a lot was going on behind the scenes!

Take a look at the concept art that was the first step in bringing our world of pizzas, challenges, and adventures to life. Curious to see what the early days looked like? Check it out below! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/c8867fd30cbc3dfe79d6324c34b8a5dc99c066e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/5cbea69450d48d56dc9271cd0b7bb6ee87945af5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/1c20260ca1490fb4960c4c27976f578001576c64.png[/img]
[h2]A journey into the future[/h2]
A year of change and progress is behind us, but this is only the beginning of our pizza adventure! Now it's time to look ahead and tell you what we're working on and planning for the coming months. 

At the beginning of the year, we will be focusing on further refining the AI and behaviour of the NPCs. We want the interactions you encounter during gameplay to be not only realistic but also rewarding and engaging.

We are also working on increasing the number of ingredients available in the game – we plan to double their current number, which will give you even more opportunities to create unique pizzas and experiment in the kitchen! 

These changes are just part of what we are preparing for you, and the next few months will bring even more exciting updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/fe73015d06d0b47fc756114544e4826a93b680ea.png[/img]
[h2]Thank you for being with us! 🎉[/h2]
It has been an amazing time of change, challenge, and amazing support from you - our community. Your engagement, feedback, and continued pizza passion give us the energy to keep going! 🍕❤️We wish you Happy Holidays, every success in the New Year, and of course... [b]lots of delicious pizza[/b]! 🎄✨ Thank you for being part of our journey – the best is yet to come!

Don't forget to add [b]Pizza Slice[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290]Steam wishlist[/url]. You can also hit the "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290]Follow[/url]" button to get the latest news.

If you want to share your ideas, ask questions, or just chat, join our [url=https://discord.gg/D8FUrZzTpD]Discorda[/url] – we look forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: News and progress in Pizza Simulator
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

Our work has made significant progress recently. We would like to share with you our most important achievements and our plans for the near future. In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/]Pizza Simulator[/url], we make pizzas for you with the highest quality ingredients!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/0f5c12eead05ff0612de927158b5335599a8aa88.png[/img]
[h2]Systems[/h2]
We have recently managed to implement a new system for saving and reading the game state so that you can easily return to your pizzeria at any time. We have also been working on the sound system and have started to implement it into the game. This is a big step towards an even more immersive experience. We assure you that you will feel like you are in a real Italian restaurant!

[h2]Characters[/h2]
[i]The Waitress[/i] - The addition of her model to the game is now behind us! We have developed and tweaked the animations to fit this character perfectly.
[i]Cousin [/i]- we've created the first version of the cousin's AI script and hope you'll see it in action soon!
[i]Customers[/i] - we have implemented a clothing and hair color generator for our much-loved but much-needed customers to give them some variety.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/e1cbb9eaf9228dc75102b65e076b6abbcc354599.png[/img]
[h2]Plans [/h2]
Our main goal at the moment is to create the right balance for the game. We will continue to work on implementing sounds into the project, refining the cousin model to accommodate animations and two events. These are the 'Sanitary Control' and 'Grandpa's Friends Package' events that we have been working on recently. We intend to introduce new mechanics and dialogues to them.

[h2]Interesting facts[/h2]
The number of customers in the restaurant will increase as the game progresses. The more developed your restaurant is, the more customers you will have. You must satisfy everyone's taste buds and not keep them waiting too long, as this will have a negative effect on the restaurant's reputation!

Stains on the floor occur when food falls to the floor and stays there for more than 5 seconds (everyone knows the 5-second rule, right?) They slow you down and can result in a fine if the health authorities visit. Remember to keep your pizzeria tidy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/02d77976a49a7f28858262d9837ee7f117f19f1a.png[/img]
Together with you, we are on our way to creating the best pizzeria the world has ever seen! Thank you for your support and patience. We invite you to join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/fYsDV3Zrgp]Discord[/url], where we can share our passion for pizza and all the tasty news. Also, remember to add [b]Pizza Simulator[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/]wishlist[/url] on Steam. Until we hear from you in the next devlog, stay tuned!

notes.title: News from the Pizza Simulator kitchen
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

It's time for another devlog full of fresh updates and news about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/]Pizza Simulator[/url]. We're adding even more flavor and flair to our game, so make yourself comfortable and get ready for some juicy information!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/ea4d84d2bf89ae2b3d0a16054f2f45793c3b8c6d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Continued work on customers[/h2]
We are currently implementing more advanced customer AI that will bring your restaurant to life like never before! Now our customers will walk the streets, take random routes, stop at different locations and continue their journey. 

[h2]Notes and alerts[/h2]
You can use the notebook to buy ingredients for the warehouse, allowing you to better manage your stock. Another thing that will make your work easier is the pop-up messages that will inform you of events or stock shortages. Each event will have a graphical representation and a very short description, making it easier for you to react quickly without having to read a long message.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/aeffe692a6ccd44d5d7b5e9f4fe0f04c9a541a5e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Preparation and playing phase[/h2]
Remember to replenish missing ingredients in the store and to clear away and wash dirty plates. During the preparation phase, the restaurant will be closed and no customers will enter. You will have plenty of time to prepare the pizzeria for another busy day. Once everything is in place, it's time for the gameplay phase, where the fun begins. Serve the incoming waves of customers, keep them happy and make them the best pizza in the world. Keep your finger on the pulse, because it's going to happen!

[h2]The cookbook[/h2]
Grandpa has left you a very valuable cookbook full of recipes that you can use to serve the best pizza in the area! New recipes will be unlocked as you develop your pizzeria. You can browse through it during the preparation phase and also during gameplay to remind yourself of the most important ingredients. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/47cd1cff83b459920e869605ac3358aaf7fe8ac3.jpg[/img]
As you can see, the work on [b]Pizza Simulator[/b] continues and shows no signs of slowing down. Another behind-the-scenes update will be coming soon, and in the meantime, you can visit our [url=https://discord.gg/fYsDV3Zrgp]Discord[/url]. Add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/]wishlist[/url] and we'll see you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Tasty innovations
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao Pizza Managers![/h1]

It's time for another devlog and lots of new goodies in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/][b]Pizza Simulator.[/b][/url] Sit back and relax as we've got a handful of updates on what we've been up to lately!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/dfcd4e8b58a3f5705b4db52c282f156114e9dcc6.jpg[/img]

[h3]New systems, new challenges[/h3]
We give you a brief introduction to the systems you will find in the game and which we have recently focused on improving:
[list]
[*] [i]Quality system[/i] - Each pizza you make can now earn you between 0 and 3 quality stars. This not only affects your income but also your Italianness points (this is the magical indicator that will play a key role in the game's development).
[*] [i]Money system [/i]- It's not just the taste that counts, but also the speed of service. The faster you can prepare a hot pizza, the more money is in the till.
[*] [i]Italianness[/i] - Your key to the next level. You earn it by taking orders, delivering pizzas and, in the future, through events such as sabotaging the competition.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/8a22cad3f5dde6d8c8a4197a5fb8d58ea83d6c6c.jpg[/img]
[h3]New graphics [/h3]
Our graphic designers have not been idle lately and we have managed to do quite a few elements, including:
[list]
[*] Player character model.
[*] Storage, dishwasher, garbage disposal, mop - in other words, everything you need when running a restaurant, right?
[*] Interior elements of the restaurant and kitchen.
[*] Main menu - here we have paid particular attention to a modern and inviting design, but also to ease of use, combining cartoon style with transparency.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/dab26cb1a70ee9fb986470ffca823e5e5872338c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Space for treasures[/h3]
We mentioned that we have recently perfected the warehouse, a place to store all the ingredients for delicious pizzas!  The space is limited by the capacity of the shelves, but don't worry, there will be larger storage facilities on the upper levels of the restaurant. At the moment, there is no way to replenish or spoil individual items, but you will eventually be able to purchase missing ingredients.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38508634/741ce380b4f243b06d2247194f7d51a2c7c878f3.jpg[/img]
Great to have you on this pizza adventure! Keep warm, follow our progress, and get ready for more tasty surprises. Remember to add [b]Pizza Simulator[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Simulator/]wishlist[/url] on Steam and check out our [url=https://discord.gg/fYsDV3Zrgp]Discord[/url]! See you in the next devlog, where we'll reveal even more delicious secrets.
